decisions.reason: Format plug-ins build on the established offer, have their own page, and cost little to maintain, so keeping this low-cost option open while adoption develops is sensible.
The building digital twin market is still highly uncertain but potentially valuable, and a mention-level service costs little to hold, so the option is worth keeping until demand becomes clearer.
Authentication delegation is close to the core offer and overlaps with the identity service, so it may later be folded into it, but for now it is cheap to keep while value resolves.
An open GIS application framework is a platform-type option that underpins further products and fits the firm's open-component strategy, so dropping it early would forgo significant upside.
The identity service was actively promoted at launch, integrates with GIS applications close to the core business, and has low holding costs, so it should be kept.
